glosses.primary_gloss: bound form in words for kinds, products, or quality
glosses.notes: Usually not a free-standing noun in modern speech. It mostly appears inside compounds such as 品种, 品质, and 食品. As a verb, it means to taste or savor something slowly and attentively, especially tea.

examples.sentence: 这种水果的品种越来越多，年轻人也愿意试新的味道。
examples.meaning_en: bound form in words for kinds / varieties

examples.sentence: 现在大家买东西的时候，不只看价格，也会看产品品质。
examples.meaning_en: bound form in words for quality

examples.sentence: 晚上没有别的事的时候，他喜欢一个人安静地品茶。

example_translations.translation: There are more and more varieties of this fruit, and young people are also willing to try new flavors.
Nowadays when people buy things, they do not just look at the price; they also look at product quality.
When he has nothing else to do in the evening, he likes to sit quietly by himself and savor tea.

glosses.notes: As an adjective, 平 describes something flat, level, or even. After verbs such as 放 or 弄, it often means to make or lay something flat.

examples.sentence: 这条路修好以后又宽又平，晚上开车也舒服多了。
桌子不平，杯子放在上面总让人觉得不放心。
她先把照片放平，再让我看看上面写了什么。

example_translations.translation: After this road was repaired, it became wide and level, and driving on it at night became much more comfortable.
The table is uneven, so putting a cup on it always makes people feel a little uneasy.
She first laid the photo flat and then let me look at what was written on it.

glosses.notes: Most often used before a noun to mark the basis, evidence, document, or means for doing something: 凭身份证, 凭经验, 凭结果. It can also mean to rely on something or someone.

examples.sentence: 不能只凭一次比赛的结果就说他没有能力。
你到了车站以后，可以凭身份证直接取票。
年轻的时候，他一直凭自己的本事生活，不愿意麻烦别人。

example_translations.translation: You cannot say he lacks ability just on the basis of the result of one competition.
After you get to the station, you can collect the ticket directly with your ID card.
When he was young, he always lived by relying on his own abilities and was unwilling to trouble other people.

glosses.notes: Describes being safe, unharmed, and free from mishap. It is very common in arrival updates and set wishes such as 一路平安.

examples.sentence: 看到孩子平安回到家，父母才真正放下心来。
只要家里人都平安，别的困难总能慢慢解决。
出门在外，大家最希望的还是一路平安。

example_translations.translation: Only after seeing the child return home safe and sound did the parents truly relax.
As long as everyone in the family is safe, other difficulties can always be solved little by little.
When away from home, what everyone hopes for most is still a safe journey.

glosses.notes: Can describe an average level or number; before quantities it often means 'on average'; as a verb it can mean to divide something evenly.

examples.sentence: 这份调查显示，年轻人的平均工资这几年一直在增加。
这家饭店周末平均每天要接待几百位客人。
为了让大家都能接受，他们决定把总费用平均分给每个人。

example_translations.translation: This survey shows that young people's average salary has kept rising over the past few years.
On weekends, this restaurant serves several hundred guests a day on average.
To make it acceptable to everyone, they decided to divide the total cost evenly among everyone.

glosses.notes: Often appears in patterns like 到齐, 排齐, and 摆齐. It can mean that everyone or everything is all there, or that things are arranged in an even, neat line.

examples.sentence: 人到齐以后，会议才正式开始，负责人先说明了讨论重点。
这几行字写得不够齐，看起来有点乱，最好再改一下。
拍照以前，老师让我们把椅子排齐，别挡住后面的人。

example_translations.translation: Once everyone had arrived, the meeting officially began, and the person in charge first explained the main discussion points.
These lines are not written evenly enough; they look a bit messy, so it is best to fix them a little.
Before taking the photo, the teacher told us to line the chairs up evenly so they would not block the people behind.

glosses.notes: Refers to what remains after one part has already been singled out. It can stand alone or come before a noun such as 人, 时间, or 部分.

examples.sentence: 这部分内容今天必须完成，其余的可以留到明天再处理。
五个人里已经有两个人决定参加，其余的人还在考虑。
前半小时先介绍情况，其余时间留给大家提问和讨论。

example_translations.translation: This part has to be finished today; the rest can be left until tomorrow to deal with.
Out of the five people, two have already decided to take part, and the others are still thinking it over.
Use the first half hour to explain the situation, and leave the remaining time for questions and discussion.

glosses.notes: Means to write your name or signature on a contract, form, or other document in order to confirm, approve, or agree.

examples.sentence: 合同的内容你最好先看清楚，再决定要不要签。
材料都准备好了，只差负责人回来在最后一页签个字。
经理还没看过，这份申请现在还不能签，我们得先等他的意见。

example_translations.translation: You should read the contents of the contract carefully first, and then decide whether to sign it.
Everything is ready; we are only waiting for the person in charge to come back and sign on the last page.
The manager has not looked at it yet, so this application cannot be signed for now; we need to wait for his opinion first.

glosses.notes: Talks about how promising a person's, job's, field's, or plan's future looks, often in evaluative phrases like 有前途 or 没前途.

examples.sentence: 这个行业虽然很辛苦，但是发展快，也很有前途。
他不想只看眼前的工资，更想考虑这份工作的前途。
家里人都支持他继续读下去，因为大家觉得他很有前途。

example_translations.translation: Although this industry is demanding, it is developing quickly and has very good future prospects.
He does not want to look only at the current salary; he wants to think more about this job's future prospects.
His family all supports him continuing his studies, because everyone thinks he has a very promising future.

glosses.notes: Here it is the verb qiē: cutting something with a knife or blade, especially food, but also paper, medicine, and other materials.

examples.sentence: 做这个菜的时候，土豆不要切得太厚，不然不容易熟。
厨师先把肉切薄一点，再放进锅里炒。
开会前，他把纸切成一样大小，方便大家做记录。

example_translations.translation: When making this dish, do not cut the potatoes too thick, or they will not cook easily.
The chef first slices the meat a bit thinner, then puts it into the wok to stir-fry it.
Before the meeting, he cut the paper into equal sizes so it would be easier for everyone to take notes.

glosses.notes: A paper or digital calendar used to check dates and write down plans, deadlines, or reminders.

examples.sentence: 我一看日历，才发现离考试只剩两个星期了。
办公室里的日历还停在上个月，难怪有人写错了日期。
我怕自己记不住，就把出发日期写在日历上了。

example_translations.translation: When I looked at the calendar, I realized there were only two weeks left before the exam.
The calendar in the office is still on last month, so no wonder someone wrote the wrong date.
I was afraid I would not remember, so I wrote the departure date on the calendar.

glosses.notes: Things people use routinely in daily life, especially household or personal-use items rather than food or larger purchases.

examples.sentence: 这家超市的日用品不算便宜，但是质量一直比较稳定。
旅行时间长的话，最好把需要的日用品提前带好。
公司给新来的员工准备了一些基本日用品。

example_translations.translation: The daily necessities at this supermarket are not exactly cheap, but the quality is consistently fairly stable.
If the trip will be long, it is best to pack the daily necessities you need in advance.
The company prepared some basic daily necessities for the new employees.
